# FragDB evaluation sample

Source: https://github.com/FragDB/fragrance-database/tree/main/samples
Publisher: https://fragdb.net
Retrieved: 2026-10-06
License: CC BY-NC 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/
Upstream license is included as LICENSE.md.

Ten real fragrance records and ten entries in each reference table. These are
limited evaluation data, not a complete catalog. The application joins the
reference tables, normalizes votes, and derives clearly marked numeric estimates.
Missing reference entries remain unresolved, not filled from guesses. The sample
contains source image URLs; no images are downloaded or republished.

Use a licensed complete database or a provider API for production/commercial use.
